assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production background asset for the existing Godot game Blue Hour. The attached approved image is the exact visual target. Extract and clean ONLY the large seaside camp scene, excluding the entire top header/navigation and the entire right sidebar and bottom-left text. Deliver the scene filling the entire output, landscape approximately 1275:804. Preserve the reference scene's framing, building positions, perspective, small crisp pixel clusters, blue-gray roofs, cool stone paving, green trees, turquoise sea, white minibus at bottom left, covered seating shelter at upper left, supply office at upper middle, workshop building at right, map table at lower center, campfire in the central courtyard, coastline and pier at upper right. IMPORTANT remove ALL four human characters from the courtyard and reconstruct the stone floor behind them; actual living characters will be separate interactive sprites. No people, no heads, no character silhouettes. Keep campfire, stools, crates and map table. No text, no UI, no health bars, no logos, no painted labels. Do not redesign or simplify the scene. Match the reference pixel rendering and crisp dark outlines; no watercolor, no vector polygons, no smooth 3D, no sepia tint, no borders, no floating diamond island. Clean full-bleed game environment plate.
